doc: What turns flow_page.html back into the prototype the maintainer accepted, specs/074-desktop-cld-flow-export/reference/mental-health-cld-flows.html in etalii.adp: each hunk replaces the template's lines with the prototype's. Each names its place of FR-035. The test applies them and compares the SHA-256, so any other change to the template fails it.
